about: Go-live clean start: what happens to every table in the public schema. EMPTY = every row removed by the one TRUNCATE in reset.sql (AuditLog then gets the single reset row, the four baseline history tables their BASELINE rows). PARTIAL = rows removed by a DELETE with the WHERE named here. KEEP = untouched, and proven byte-identical by the fingerprint. _prisma_migrations is untouched and listed under ignored. tests/unit/clean-start-tables.test.ts pins this list to prisma/schema.prisma, and tests/unit/clean-start-sql.test.ts pins the SQL files to this list.

PARTIAL.CronRun: "at" < (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat')::date - 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Muscat' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
